vocabulary.meaning_en: to communicate an idea or feeling to someone
vocabulary.example: She conveyed her ideas very clearly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: clear and exact
vocabulary.example: Please give specific instructions.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to already have an idea or plan
vocabulary.example: I have a specific design in mind.

vocabulary.meaning_en: opinions or ideas
vocabulary.example: I'd like to hear your thoughts on the plan.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make something better
vocabulary.example: How can we improve this design?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the ability to plan how something will look and work
vocabulary.example: We need your design skills for this project.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make something, often in large numbers
vocabulary.example: The factory produces 1,000 chairs a day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give official approval to something
vocabulary.example: The manager must sign off the plan.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to start being made in a factory
vocabulary.example: The new phone goes into production next month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the first model of a new product, made for testing
vocabulary.example: We showed the prototype to our clients.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to create a new product or idea and make it better
vocabulary.example: They are developing a new app.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the group of people who design and make new products
vocabulary.example: Talk to the development team on the 4th floor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who designs and makes new products or software
vocabulary.example: She is a software developer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the things that are needed
vocabulary.example: Please explain your requirements exactly.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to start an activity or project
vocabulary.example: Let's get the ball rolling with a short meeting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to start managing a situation
vocabulary.example: Sometimes a leader must take control.

vocabulary.meaning_en: long (used for measurement)
vocabulary.example: The table is two metres in length.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to be clear and easy to understand
vocabulary.example: Does that make sense?

vocabulary.meaning_en: very good, making you admire it
vocabulary.example: Your report is very impressive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to start dealing with a task
vocabulary.example: I'll get onto it straight away.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to happen in the way that was planned
vocabulary.example: I hope everything goes to plan.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to officially agree that something is good enough
vocabulary.example: The boss approved the budget.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a gift you give a colleague who is leaving the job
vocabulary.example: We bought her a leaving present.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to end someone's job (polite)
vocabulary.example: It's hard to let a member of staff go.

fine_lines.title: sign vs sign off
fine_lines.explanation_ar: sign تعني تكتب توقيعك. sign off تعني تعتمد الشيء رسميًا وتوافق عليه (قد يكون بالتوقيع أو بالموافقة). وفي الرسائل sign off تعني أيضًا تنهي الرسالة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Sign' means write your name. 'Sign off' means give official approval to something.

examples.sentence: I need to sign off your designs before production.

fine_lines.title: produce vs develop
fine_lines.explanation_ar: develop تعني تصميم منتج جديد وتحسينه (مرحلة الفكرة والنموذج). produce تعني تصنيعه، غالبًا بكميات كبيرة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Develop = design and improve a new product. Produce = make it, often in large numbers.

examples.sentence: The team is developing a prototype.

expressions.phrase: I have a specific idea in mind.
expressions.meaning_en: I already know exactly what I want.
expressions.example: For the new logo, I have a specific idea in mind.

expressions.phrase: I'm interested in hearing your thoughts on how to improve my idea.
expressions.meaning_ar: يهمني أن أسمع آراءك حول كيفية تحسين فكرتي.
expressions.meaning_en: Please tell me how to make my idea better.
expressions.example: I'm interested in hearing your thoughts on how to improve the website.

expressions.phrase: I'd like to use your design skills to produce a fantastic product.
expressions.meaning_ar: أود الاستفادة من مهاراتك في التصميم لإنتاج منتج رائع.
expressions.meaning_en: I want your design help to make a great product.
expressions.example: I'd like to use your design skills to produce a great brochure.

expressions.phrase: I need to sign off your designs before they go into production.
expressions.meaning_ar: يجب أن أعتمد تصاميمك قبل أن تدخل مرحلة الإنتاج.
expressions.meaning_en: I must approve the designs before they are made.
expressions.example: I need to sign off the plans before the builders start.

expressions.meaning_en: Do you understand what I said?
expressions.example: Send the report by Friday, then I'll check it. Does that make sense?

expressions.phrase: I'll get onto it straight away.
expressions.meaning_en: I will start doing it immediately.
expressions.example: Sure, I'll get onto it straight away.
We have the budget, so let's get the ball rolling.

grammar.title: interested in + -ing
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد interested in نستخدم الاسم أو الفعل بصيغة ing: I'm interested in hearing your thoughts. لا نقول interested to hear في هذا المعنى غالبًا.
grammar.explanation_en: After 'interested in' use a noun or verb + -ing.
examples: I'm interested in hearing your thoughts.
Are you interested in joining the team?

grammar.title: I'd like to... / I need to... (polite but firm)
grammar.explanation_ar: I'd like to تعبّر عن رغبة مهذبة، و I need to تعبّر عن ضرورة أو واجب. يستخدمهما المدير ليكون واضحًا ومهذبًا في آن واحد.
grammar.explanation_en: 'I'd like to' is a polite wish; 'I need to' shows necessity. Together they are clear but polite.
examples: I'd like to use your design skills.
I need to sign off your designs.
I'd like to see the plans by Monday.

grammar.title: before + present simple for future
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد before و after و when نستخدم المضارع البسيط حتى لو كنا نتحدث عن المستقبل: before they go into production (وليس will go).
grammar.explanation_en: After before, after and when, use the present simple for the future.
examples: I need to sign off your designs before they go into production.
We'll check it after it arrives.

questions.question: What is a 'prototype'?
choices: a first model of a new product, for testing
questions.explanation_en: A prototype is a first test model.

questions.question: I need to ___ your designs before they go into production.
I need to approve the designs before they ___ into production.
Anna has a ___ idea in mind: 20 cm long, black-purple, with a curve.
Which question checks that someone understood you?
questions.explanation_ar: Does that make sense? = هل هذا مفهوم؟

questions.question: 'I'll get onto it straight away' means ___.
choices: I'll start working on it now
I'll give it to someone else

questions.question: Which word means 'the things that are needed'?
The team will ___ the product first, then the factory will ___ it.
